title: Negative / mixed modality evidence summary
metric: qualitative classification per modality (see numeric_support for governing numbers)
sample_unit: modality (n=4: second-site PPG, leg BioZ, thoracic EIS, EEG-EOG-respiration interaction)
uncertainty_meaning: each modality's own numeric_support field carries its governing sd/n; no cross-modality aggregation is performed
claim_boundary: These results must remain visible in any final presentation - never omitted to present a cleaner minimalism story.

second_site_ppg.finding: A second PPG measurement site did not demonstrate stable aggregate incremental value for HR/PTT estimation under the tested protocol, and the result is fragile to subject exclusion.
second_site_ppg.numeric_support: B_minus_A=+1.462 MAE (worse); n=4 held-out test subjects.

leg_bioz.finding: Additional leg BioZ did not demonstrate stable aggregate incremental value in the terrestrial body-mass-change proxy experiment and remained heterogeneous/sensitivity-fragile.
leg_bioz.numeric_support: A_minus_B=-0.052 (aggregate disfavors B); 7/10 subjects individually favor B.

thoracic_eis.finding: Under the frozen terrestrial 0-60 mmHg LBNP protocol, thoracic EIS did not show stable aggregate incremental value beyond ECG+pleth, with substantial subject heterogeneity.
thoracic_eis.numeric_support: A_minus_B=-0.452 (sign-reverses w/o subject 9); C_minus_B=-1.293 (shrinks substantially w/o subject 9); classification COMPLETE_MIXED.

sleep_interaction.finding: No stable evidence of synergy or antagonism between EOG and respiration-derived features for sleep staging under the tested protocol.
